routes.selection: First train route for each observed nA count, not selected by output error or speed.

fixture.input: Explicit fixture, not real captured activation: NumPy PCG64 seed20261102, standard_normal F32 vector1536 per case.
fixture.alpha: Explicit fixture, not router scores: F32[1,2,3,4,5,6]/21 in original selected expert order.

quantization.source: Original GGUF dequantized logical row; each row fixed across layouts.
quantization.rounding: F32 division; nearest with half ties away; clip
quantization.activation: Full GU1536 input quantized once and reused; each entire512/1024 SwiGLU private down vector quantized once.
quantization.output: I32 exact CPU dot (max bound24774144), convert once F32 then multiply F32(rowScale*inputScale).
quantization.scale_storage: Host logical_scales.f32, recomposed by saved logical row offsets; no scalar-free I8 assumption.

geometry.physical: Linear virtualchip files map every four16KiB plane pages to a wordline; each native run starts plane0 and never crosses block.
geometry.routed_gu: Onecopy source g8 rows128; canonical logical order gate512 then up512.
geometry.shared_gu: Logical gate1024 then up1024; adjacent128row tiles2p,2p+1 stored at paired chips; replica coalesces256rows.

setup_and_audit_wall_seconds.note: Software preparation/audit timing only; not NAND or inference latency.

limitations: Isolated FFN layer with fixed fixture inputs/scores and real old train routes, not end-to-end inference or quality/routing revalidation.
Functional W8 re-quantization changes original GGUF values; both compared layouts use identical fixed W8 rows and host scales.
Uses ordinary dense whole-row GEMV composition and host concatenation; no new MAC or multiple chip contexts. CPU I32 is a reference, not proof nativeAiF returns I32/FP32 raw exact results.
Virtual block/page descriptors and file pread are executable address evidence, not verified native driver/controller ABI or NAND execution.
No hardware latency claim: host activation/scaling/reassembly, controller dispatch, ECC/MAC and DMA need calibration. Address-read order is numeric execution, not concurrent scheduler validation.
Additional replicas occupy3MiB useful bytes, but both layer layouts reserve one12MiB block/chip in this virtual allocator; report both capacity measures.
Shared expert replication/dynamic owner choice has direct prior; this artifact validates mapping and arithmetic only.
